intro: Away from the keyboard I'm usually holding a different kind of instrument. Guitar and bass are home; accordion and drums I can fake convincingly enough to have fun. Time in an orchestra, a vocal jazz group, and both a jazz and a rock band – there's a gold medal from the Maine Jazz Festival on bass somewhere.

songOfTheDay.title: Teen Town
songOfTheDay.note: Jaco's bass line – still chasing that feel.
